name: TetWeave Optimization Pipeline
definition: Optimizes a set of 3D points, their scalar field (SDF) values, and spherical harmonic coefficients to reconstruct a target 3D mesh from 2D multi-view images (mask, depth, normals) using tetrahedralization and differentiable rendering.
summary: TetWeave Optimization Pipeline reconstructs 3D meshes from multi-view images by coupling tetrahedralization with differentiable rendering to jointly optimize geometry and appearance without explicit mesh parameterization.
